description: This file defines the 'AccountTransfersWritePlatformService' interface, outlining methods related to account transfer operations within the account management system of the project.

classes.name: AccountTransfersWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining operations for account transfer management and processing.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new account transfer based on the provided command.

methods.name: reverseTransfersWithFromAccountType
methods.description: Reverses transfers associated with a specific account number and account type.

methods.name: transferFunds
methods.description: Performs a fund transfer based on the transfer data in the DTO.

methods.name: reverseAllTransactions
methods.description: Reverses all transactions for a given account ID and account type.

methods.name: refundByTransfer
methods.description: Processes a refund based on a transfer command.

methods.name: reverseTransfersWithFromAccountTransactions
methods.description: Reverses transfers associated with specific transaction IDs.

methods.name: repayLoanWithTopup
methods.description: Repays a loan with a top-up based on the transfer DTO.
